name: ChatGPT for PowerPoint
desc: A PowerPoint sidebar that drafts, revises and explains your deck.
desc_zh: PowerPoint 侧边栏里的助手，负责起草、修改和讲解你的演示稿。
solves: Rebuilding a deck in another tool loses the template. The add-in works on the real file, and slides stay editable in PowerPoint afterwards.
solves_zh: 换一个工具重做演示稿，模板就丢了。这个加载项直接改原文件，做完之后幻灯片在 PowerPoint 里依然可编辑。
best_for: A deck exists and needs a rewrite, or notes need turning into slides.
best_for_zh: 手上有一份要重写的演示稿，或者要把素材变成幻灯片。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — ChatGPT release notes, https://help.openai.com/en/articles/6825453-chatgpt-r）。 Date corrected to 2026-07-06: the entry sits under the "July 6, 2026" heading of the ChatGPT release notes, not June. No earlier first-party beta announcement was found in the release notes or the OpenAI news feed, so the GA date is used. 入库核对（2026-11-25）：嵌在演示文稿软件里的 ChatGPT，与账本对 Microsoft 365 Copilot 的分类一致。 首次公开日期来源：https://help.openai.com/en/articles/6825453-chatgpt-release-notes
